phase: Fiscal Reaction Selective Reopen — Pre-2022 UBLGBPS Source Probe Review

target.concept: Structural balance of general government excluding interest; adjustment based on potential GDP; excessive deficit procedure

ambiguous_release.reason: The archive itself contains two distinct official UBLGBPS rows. No release-note evidence has been retained that authorizes silently choosing one over the other.

spring_first_historical_chain.rule: Use the first Spring full-forecast vintage after each completed year; this gives one annual release-time target observation and avoids double-counting Spring/Autumn revisions of the same completed year.

historical_coverage_structure.warning: The historical support set changes between Spring 2014 and Spring 2015. A real-time expanding-origin design may not pretend that a single fixed historical panel existed throughout.

predecessor_family_observation.concept: Net lending (+) or net borrowing (-) excluding interest of general government adjusted for the cyclical component
predecessor_family_observation.rule: Longer UBLGBP history may not replace UBLGBPS merely because the structural-primary real-time window is shorter. Any UBLGBP cycle requires a separately preregistered measurement-family decision justified independently of observed model performance or sample convenience.

validation_implication.prior_cycle_windows: 1996..2009 calibration; 2010..2017 structural selection; 2018..2024 untouched final evaluation
validation_implication.reason: No exact UBLGBPS vintage exists before Spring 2014, and stable later vintages do not reproduce the old 1996-2009 calibration information set. The earlier 29-target-year design therefore cannot be re-labelled as a real-time UBLGBPS validation design.
validation_implication.note: The source result constrains validation design; it does not by itself prove that every future parsimonious structural-primary model is unidentifiable.

next_gate: Preserve the exact 2014-2026 UBLGBPS raw release bytes permanently under the repository source-vintage contract and freeze the semantic distinction between UBLGBPS structural primary balance and UBLGBP cyclically adjusted primary balance. Do not open a new reaction-function design merely from the longer predecessor-family history.
